items.title: ICF International (ICFI) Is Up 5.1% After Reaffirming 2026 Guidance Backed By Robust Backlog
items.summary: ICF International, Inc. reported past second-quarter 2026 results with US$474.5 million in sales, higher net income year on year, and reaffirmed its 2026 revenue guidance of US$1.89 billion to US$1.96 billion and GAAP EPS guidance of US$5.95 to US$6.25, supported by a backlog covering about 90% of the midpoint revenue target. items.title: ICF International (ICFI) Lands $35 Million Energy Efficiency Contract
items.summary: ICF International (NasdaqGS: ICFI) secured a new US$35 million contract with Entergy Louisiana, LLC to lead the utility's energy efficiency portfolio. The long term agreement covers a comprehensive set of programs focused on grid reliability and customer cost savings. The contract reinforces ICF International's role in large scale energy efficiency and utility program delivery. This kind of long term power grid work points to a broader theme in energy infrastructure that is worth exploring...
